t: Under the portico of St Martin-in-the-Fields, at the edge of Trafalgar Square, you're looking at a small stone baby. This is Christ Child, also called In the Beginning, a sculpture by Michael Chapman. It was commissioned for the millennium and carved from a 4.5-tonne block of Portland stone. Chapman says a tiny, life-size baby in such an enormous space was the best way to remind us whose birthday Christmas celebrates. The opening of the Gospel of John is inscribed around it: in the beginning was the word, and the word became flesh and lived among us. It has been called strikingly modern.
